notes: Simulation-only uniform 60x40x40 mm box at ideal fixed grasp/suction positions. Dimensions, poses and COM are declared assumptions, not measurements. The 0.5 and 1.0 kg masses are experimental conditions. No real grasp, contact or pneumatic behavior is modeled.
ag145_rating_reference: https://en.dh-robotics.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Servo-Electric-Gripper_DH-Robotics_EN2303.pdf (AG-105-145: 145 mm stroke, 2 kg recommended workpiece mass; dynamic safety depends on grasp/material/acceleration)
mdpg_rating_reference: User-provided DC PNEUMATIC GRIPPER_1 image (1.5 kg maximum payload; suction force and retention not verified)

ag145_p05.source_note: 60x40x40 mm box centered at z=0.175 m between nominal AG145 collision fingers; geometry and grasp location are unmeasured. 0.5 kg is below the maker's 2 kg recommended workpiece mass, not a dynamic safety approval.
